    99	    raise ValueError("nonfinite JSON number")

   102	def unique_object(pairs):
   103	    result = {}
   104	    for key, value in pairs:
   105	        if key in result:
   106	            raise ValueError("duplicate JSON key")
   107	        result[key] = value
   108	    return result

   111	def parse_json(raw):
   112	    """Decode one UTF-8 JSON value, rejecting extensions and duplicate keys."""
   113	    try:
   114	        text = raw.decode("utf-8")
   115	        if text.startswith("\ufeff"):
   116	            raise ValueError("UTF-8 BOM is not permitted")
   117	        return json.loads(
   118	            text,
   119	            object_pairs_hook=unique_object,
   120	            parse_constant=reject_constant
   121	        )
   122	    except (ValueError, UnicodeError, RecursionError) as error:
   123	        raise ValueError("invalid UTF-8 JSON") from error

   126	def canonical_address(value):
   127	    return str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(value))

   130	def parse_ipv6_address(text):
   131	    if not isinstance(text, str) or "%" in text or any(c.isspace() for c in text):
   132	        raise ValueError("invalid IPv6 address")
   133	    try:
   134	        value = int(ipaddress.IPv6Address(text))
   135	    except (ipaddress.AddressValueError, ValueError) as error:
   136	        raise ValueError("invalid IPv6 address") from error
   137	    if value >> 96 != DOCUMENTATION_PREFIX:
   138	        raise ValueError("IPv6 address is outside 2001:db8::/32")
   139	    return value
   140	
   141	
   142	def parse_prefix(text):
   143	    if not isinstance(text, str) or "%" in text or any(c.isspace() for c in text):
   144	        raise ValueError("invalid IPv6 prefix")
   145	    if text.count("/") != 1:
   146	        raise ValueError("prefix must have an explicit length")
   147	    address_text, length_text = text.split("/")
   148	    if length_text not in ("56", "64"):
   149	        raise ValueError("prefix length must be /56 or /64")
   150	    value = parse_ipv6_address(address_text)
   151	    length = int(length_text)
   152	    host_bits = 128 - length
   153	    if value & ((1 << host_bits) - 1):
   154	        raise ValueError("prefix has nonzero host bits")
   155	    return value, length

   158	def require_integer(value, name, minimum, maximum):
   159	    if type(value) is not int or not minimum <= value <= maximum:
   160	        raise ValueError("invalid integer field: " + name)
   161

   163	def require_exact_keys(value, keys, name):
   164	    if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != keys:
   165	        raise ValueError("invalid object: " + name)

   168	def load_manifest(path):
   169	    raw = read_regular_file(path, MANIFEST_LIMIT)
   170	    value = parse_json(raw)
   171	    require_exact_keys(value, MANIFEST_KEYS, "manifest")
   172	
   173	    if type(value["version"]) is not int or value["version"] != 1:
   174	        raise ValueError("manifest version must be 1")
   175	    require_integer(value["seed"], "seed", 0, (1 << 64) - 1)
   176	    require_integer(value["low_count"], "low_count", 1, 32)
   177	    require_integer(value["attempts"], "attempts", 1, 3)
   178	    require_integer(value["spacing_ms"], "spacing_ms", 1, 1000)
   179	    require_integer(value["timeout_ms"], "timeout_ms", 1, 1000000)
   180	
   181	    raw_windows = value["windows"]
   182	    if not isinstance(raw_windows, list) or len(raw_windows) > 8:
   183	        raise ValueError("invalid windows array")
   184	
   185	    windows = []
   186	    window_ids = set()
   187	    total_segments = 0
   188	    for raw_window in raw_windows:
   189	        require_exact_keys(raw_window, WINDOW_KEYS, "window")
   190	        window_id = raw_window["id"]
   191	        if not isinstance(window_id, str) or ID_RE.fullmatch(window_id) is None:
   192	            raise ValueError("invalid window ID")
   193	        if window_id in window_ids:
   194	            raise ValueError("duplicate window ID")
   195	        window_ids.add(window_id)
   196	        require_integer(raw_window["start_ms"], "start_ms", 0, 10 ** 12)
   197	
   198	        raw_scopes = raw_window["scopes"]
   199	        if not isinstance(raw_scopes, list) or len(raw_scopes) > 32:
   200	            raise ValueError("invalid scopes array")
   201	        scope_ids = set()
   202	        selected_networks = set()
   203	        segments = []
   204	        for raw_scope in raw_scopes:
   205	            require_exact_keys(raw_scope, SCOPE_KEYS, "scope")
   206	            scope_id = raw_scope["id"]
   207	            if not isinstance(scope_id, str) or ID_RE.fullmatch(scope_id) is None:
   208	                raise ValueError("invalid scope ID")
   209	            if scope_id in scope_ids:
   210	                raise ValueError("duplicate scope ID in window")
   211	            scope_ids.add(scope_id)
   212	
   213	            prefix_base, prefix_length = parse_prefix(raw_scope["prefix"])
   214	            subnets = raw_scope["subnets"]
   215	            if not isinstance(subnets, list):
   216	                raise ValueError("invalid subnets array")
   217	            if any(type(subnet) is not int for subnet in subnets):
   218	                raise ValueError("subnet must be an integer")
   219	            if len(set(subnets)) != len(subnets):
   220	                raise ValueError("duplicate subnet")
   221	            if prefix_length == 56:
   222	                if not 1 <= len(subnets) <= 256:
   223	                    raise ValueError("invalid /56 subnet count")
   224	                if any(not 0 <= subnet <= 255 for subnet in subnets):
   225	                    raise ValueError("invalid /56 subnet")
   226	            elif subnets != [0]:
   227	                raise ValueError("a /64 scope must select exactly subnet 0")
   228	
   229	            for subnet in sorted(subnets):
   230	                base = prefix_base + (subnet << 64)
   231	                if base in selected_networks:
   232	                    raise ValueError("overlapping selected /64 networks")
   233	                selected_networks.add(base)
   234	                segments.append({
   235	                    "scope": scope_id,
   236	                    "subnet": subnet,
   237	                    "base": base,
   238	                })
   239	                total_segments += 1
   240	                if total_segments > 2048:
   241	                    raise ValueError("too many selected /64 networks")
   242	
   243	        segments.sort(key=lambda segment: (segment["scope"], segment["subnet"]))
   244	        windows.append({
   245	            "id": window_id,
   246	            "start_ms": raw_window["start_ms"],
   247	            "segments": segments,
   248	        })
   249	
   250	    windows.sort(key=lambda window: window["id"])
   251	    return {
   252	        "seed": value["seed"],
   253	        "low_count": value["low_count"],
   254	        "attempts": value["attempts"],
   255	        "spacing_ms": value["spacing_ms"],
   256	        "timeout_ms": value["timeout_ms"],
   257	        "windows": windows,
   258	    }

   261	def read_regular_file(path, maximum):
   262	    if path == "-":
   263	        raise ValueError("standard input is not an input file")
   264	    try:
   265	        info = os.stat(path)
   266	        if not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode):
   267	            raise ValueError("input is not a regular file")
   268	        if info.st_size > maximum:
   269	            raise ValueError("input file is too large")
   270	        with open(path, "rb") as stream:
   271	            if not stat.S_ISREG(os.fstat(stream.fileno()).st_mode):
   272	                raise ValueError("input is not a regular file")
   273	            raw = stream.read(maximum + 1)
   274	    except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
   275	        if isinstance(error, ValueError):
   276	            raise
   277	        raise ValueError("cannot read input file") from error
   278	    if len(raw) > maximum:
   279	        raise ValueError("input file is too large")
   280	    return raw

   283	def canary_values(seed, window, scope, network):
   284	    material = (
   285	        "ipv6-evidence-v1\n" + str(seed) + "\n" + window + "\n" +
   286	        scope + "\n" + network + "\n"
   287	    ).encode("ascii")
   288	    c0 = int.from_bytes(hashlib.sha256(material).digest()[:8], "big")
   289	    c0 |= 1 << 63
   290	    return c0, c0 ^ 1

   293	def construct_plan(model):
   294	    probes = []
   295	    segments = []
   296	    low_count = model["low_count"]
   297	    attempts = model["attempts"]
   298	    spacing = model["spacing_ms"]
   299	    timeout = model["timeout_ms"]
   300	
   301	    for window in model["windows"]:
   302	        window_id = window["id"]
   303	        ordinal = 0
   304	        for description in window["segments"]:
   305	            scope = description["scope"]
   306	            subnet = description["subnet"]
   307	            base = description["base"]
   308	            network = canonical_address(base) + "/64"
   309	            canaries = canary_values(model["seed"], window_id, scope, network)
   310	            segment = Segment(window_id, scope, subnet, base, canaries)
   311	            segments.append(segment)
   312	            id_prefix = window_id + "/" + scope + "/" + str(subnet) + "/"
   313	
   314	            for iid in range(1, low_count + 1):
   315	                target_value = base | iid
   316	                low_target = LowTarget(target_value)
   317	                segment.targets.append(low_target)
   318	                for attempt in range(attempts):
   319	                    sent = window["start_ms"] + ordinal * spacing
   320	                    probe_id = (
   321	                        id_prefix + "low-" + str(iid) + "/" + str(attempt)
   322	                    )
   323	                    probes.append(Probe(
   324	                        probe_id, segment, target_value, low_target.address,
   325	                        "low", iid, attempt, sent, sent + timeout, low_target,
   326	                    ))
   327	                    ordinal += 1
   328	
   329	            for slot, iid in enumerate(canaries):
   330	                target_value = base | iid
   331	                target = canonical_address(target_value)
   332	                for attempt in range(attempts):
   333	                    sent = window["start_ms"] + ordinal * spacing
   334	                    probe_id = (
   335	                        id_prefix + "canary-" + str(slot) + "/" + str(attempt)
   336	                    )
   337	                    probes.append(Probe(
   338	                        probe_id, segment, target_value, target, "canary",
   339	                        slot, attempt, sent, sent + timeout,
   340	                    ))
   341	                    ordinal += 1
   342	    return probes, segments
   343

   345	def make_plan(manifest_path):
   346	    model = load_manifest(manifest_path)
   347	    probes, _ = construct_plan(model)
   348	    return {"version": 1, "probes": [probe.as_json() for probe in probes]}

   351	def sorted_addresses(values):
   352	    return [canonical_address(value) for value in sorted(values)]

   355	def reconcile_segments(segments, attempts):
   356	    output = []
   357	    for segment in segments:
   358	        overlap = segment.internal & segment.external
   359	        if segment.canary_hits == {0, 1}:
   360	            state = "alias_suspect"
   361	        elif overlap:
   362	            state = "ambiguous"
   363	        else:
   364	            state = "usable"
   365	
   366	        if state != "usable":
   367	            exposure = "excluded"
   368	        elif segment.internal:
   369	            exposure = "observed_internal_reply"
   370	        else:
   371	            exposure = "inconclusive"
   372	
   373	        targets = []
   374	        for low_target in segment.targets:
   375	            internal_attempts = sorted(low_target.internal_attempts)
   376	            external_attempts = sorted(low_target.external_attempts)
   377	            if state == "alias_suspect":
   378	                classification = "alias_suspect"
   379	            elif state == "ambiguous":
   380	                classification = "ambiguous"
   381	            elif internal_attempts and external_attempts:
   382	                classification = "mixed"
   383	            elif internal_attempts:
   384	                classification = "internal"
   385	            elif external_attempts:
   386	                classification = "external"
   387	            else:
   388	                classification = "unknown"
   389	
   390	            targets.append({
   391	                "address": low_target.address,
   392	                "classification": classification,
   393	                "internal_attempts": internal_attempts,
   394	                "external_attempts": external_attempts,
   395	                "external_sources": sorted_addresses(low_target.external_sources),
   396	                "silent_attempts": [
   397	                    attempt for attempt in range(attempts)
   398	                    if attempt not in low_target.responded_attempts
   399	                ],
   400	            })
   401	
   402	        output.append({
   403	            "window": segment.window,
   404	            "scope": segment.scope,
   405	            "subnet": segment.subnet,
   406	            "network": segment.network,
   407	            "state": state,
   408	            "exposure": exposure,
   409	            "canary_hits": sorted(segment.canary_hits),
   410	            "internal": sorted_addresses(segment.internal),
   411	            "external": sorted_addresses(segment.external),
   412	            "overlap": sorted_addresses(overlap),
   413	            "targets": targets,
   414	        })
   415	    return output

   418	def open_responses(path):
   419	    if path == "-":
   420	        raise ValueError("standard input is not an input file")
   421	    try:
   422	        info = os.stat(path)
   423	        if not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode):
   424	            raise ValueError("input is not a regular file")
   425	        if info.st_size > RESPONSES_LIMIT:
   426	            raise ValueError("response file is too large")
   427	        stream = open(path, "rb")
   428	    except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
   429	        if isinstance(error, ValueError):
   430	            raise
   431	        raise ValueError("cannot read response file") from error
   432	    if not stat.S_ISREG(os.fstat(stream.fileno()).st_mode):
   433	        stream.close()
   434	        raise ValueError("input is not a regular file")
   435	    return stream

   438	def replay(manifest_path, responses_path):
   439	    model = load_manifest(manifest_path)
   440	    probes, segments = construct_plan(model)
   441	    probe_by_id = {probe.id: probe for probe in probes}
   442	    attempts = model["attempts"]
   443	
   444	    accepted_rows = 0
   445	    duplicate_rows = 0
   446	    diagnostics = []
   447	    accepted_tuples = set()
   448	    total_bytes = 0
   449	    line_number = 0
   450	
   451	    stream = open_responses(responses_path)
   452	    try:
   453	        while True:
   454	            raw = stream.readline(PHYSICAL_LINE_LIMIT + 1)
   455	            if not raw:
   456	                break
   457	            total_bytes += len(raw)
   458	            line_number += 1
   459	            if total_bytes > RESPONSES_LIMIT:
   460	                raise ValueError("response file is too large")
   461	            if line_number > RESPONSES_LINE_LIMIT:
   462	                raise ValueError("too many response lines")
   463	            if len(raw) > PHYSICAL_LINE_LIMIT:
   464	                raise ValueError("physical response line is too long")
   465	
   466	            reason = None
   467	            try:
   468	                row = parse_json(raw)
   469	            except ValueError:
   470	                diagnostics.append({"line": line_number, "reason": "json"})
   471	                continue
   472	
   473	            if not isinstance(row, dict) or set(row) != ROW_KEYS:
   474	                reason = "schema"
   475	            elif (
   476	                not isinstance(row["probe_id"], str) or
   477	                not isinstance(row["target"], str) or
   478	                not isinstance(row["source"], str) or
   479	                not 1 <= len(row["probe_id"]) <= 200 or
   480	                type(row["received_ms"]) is not int or
   481	                type(row["type"]) is not int or
   482	                type(row["code"]) is not int
   483	            ):
   484	                reason = "schema"
   485	
   486	            if reason is None:
   487	                try:
   488	                    target_value = parse_ipv6_address(row["target"])
   489	                    source_value = parse_ipv6_address(row["source"])
   490	                except ValueError:
   491	                    reason = "address"
   492	
   493	            probe = None
   494	            if reason is None:
   495	                probe = probe_by_id.get(row["probe_id"])
   496	                if probe is None:
   497	                    reason = "unknown_probe"
   498	            if reason is None and target_value != probe.target_value:
   499	                reason = "target_mismatch"
   500	            if reason is None and not (
   501	                probe.sent_ms <= row["received_ms"] < probe.deadline_ms
   502	            ):
   503	                reason = "time"
   504	            if reason is None:
   505	                message_type = row["type"]
   506	                code = row["code"]
   507	                if not (
   508	                    (message_type == 129 and code == 0) or
   509	                    (message_type == 1 and 0 <= code <= 6)
   510	                ):
   511	                    reason = "icmp"
   512	
   513	            if reason is not None:
   514	                diagnostics.append({"line": line_number, "reason": reason})
   515	                continue
   516	
   517	            key = (
   518	                probe.id, row["received_ms"], target_value, source_value,
   519	                message_type, code,
   520	            )
   521	            if key in accepted_tuples:
   522	                duplicate_rows += 1
   523	                continue
   524	            accepted_tuples.add(key)
   525	            accepted_rows += 1
   526	
   527	            segment = probe.segment
   528	            is_echo = message_type == 129
   529	            same_source = source_value == target_value
   530	            if probe.role == "canary":
   531	                if is_echo and same_source:
   532	                    segment.canary_hits.add(probe.slot)
   533	                continue
   534	
   535	            low_target = probe.low_target
   536	            attempt = probe.attempt
   537	            low_target.responded_attempts.add(attempt)
   538	            if is_echo and same_source:
   539	                segment.internal.add(target_value)
   540	                low_target.internal_attempts.add(attempt)
   541	            elif not is_echo and not same_source:
   542	                segment.external.add(source_value)
   543	                low_target.external_attempts.add(attempt)
   544	                low_target.external_sources.add(source_value)
   545	    finally:
   546	        stream.close()
   547	
   548	    result_segments = reconcile_segments(segments, attempts)
   549	
   550	    return {
   551	        "version": 1,
   552	        "accepted_rows": accepted_rows,
   553	        "duplicate_rows": duplicate_rows,
   554	        "diagnostics": diagnostics,
   555	        "segments": result_segments,
   556	    }

   559	def main():
   560	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)
   561	    if any(arg in {"-h", "--help"} for arg in sys.argv[1:]):
   562	        parser.error("help switches are not supported")
   563	    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
   564	    plan = sub.add_parser("plan", add_help=False)
   565	    plan.add_argument("manifest")
   566	    replay_parser = sub.add_parser("replay", add_help=False)
   567	    replay_parser.add_argument("manifest")
   568	    replay_parser.add_argument("responses")
   569	    args = parser.parse_args()
   570	    try:
   571	        result = (
   572	            make_plan(args.manifest) if args.command == "plan"
   573	            else replay(args.manifest, args.responses)
   574	        )
   575	        output = json.dumps(result, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False)
   576	    except (ValueError, OSError, RecursionError) as error:
   577	        print(str(error) or "invalid input", file=sys.stderr)
   578	        return 2
   579	    print(output)
   580	    return 0

   583	if __name__ == "__main__":
   584	    sys.exit(main())
